ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, it can be seen that Y, S, W are on the same horizontal line, XY is the vertical line passing through Y, and P, S, Q are on the same vertical line; there are right-angle markings in the figure, indicating that these horizontal lines and vertical lines are perpendicular to each other. The oblique line RP passes through Y and P, the oblique line XW passes through X and W, and the problem statement gives PR ∥ WX. Then reason: Because PR ∥ WX, the small right triangle PSY and the large right triangle XYW have one pair of hypotenuse directions parallel, and both contain a right angle formed by a horizontal side and a vertical side, so the two triangles are similar. The correspondence is PS corresponds to XY, and SY corresponds to YW. Given PS = 3, XY = 6, so the similarity ratio is PS/XY = 3/6 = 1/2. Therefore SY/YW = 1/2. Also WY = 8, so SY = 8 × 1/2 = 4.

method.method_draft: 先看图：Y、S、W在同一条水平线上，XY和PQ都是竖直线，图上还标出PR ∥ WX，且水平线与竖直线成直角。于是小直角三角形PSY与大直角三角形XYW相似，边PS对应XY，边SY对应YW。由PS/XY = 3/6 = 1/2，得到SY = (1/2)·WY = (1/2)·8 = 4。
